LABEL: spatiotemporal region
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'occurrent part of' only 'spatiotemporal region'|'temporal part of' only 'spatiotemporal region'

LABEL: process

LABEL: one-dimensional spatial region

LABEL: three-dimensional spatial region

LABEL: site

LABEL: process boundary
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'has occurrent part' only 'process boundary'|'has temporal part' only 'process boundary'|'occurrent part of' only (process or 'process boundary')|'temporal part of' only (process or 'process boundary')

LABEL: one-dimensional temporal region
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'has temporal part' only ('one-dimensional temporal region' or 'zero-dimensional temporal region')|'temporal part of' only 'one-dimensional temporal region'

LABEL: material entity
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'continuant part of at some time' only 'material entity'|'has continuant part at some time' only (site or 'material entity' or 'continuant fiat boundary')

LABEL: continuant fiat boundary

LABEL: process profile

iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: process that is proper part of another process and that captures the time-dependent behavior of some attribute of that process

LABEL: fiat surface
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'has continuant part at some time' only 'continuant fiat boundary'

LABEL: fiat point
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'has continuant part at some time' only 'fiat point'

LABEL: zero-dimensional temporal region
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'has temporal part' only 'zero-dimensional temporal region'

LABEL: action specification
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: information content entity that prescribes what participants shall do in a process

LABEL: Advance Shipment Notice
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'is output of' some ('shipment preparation process' and ('has participant at some time' some (supplier or (('business organization' or person) and ('has role' some 'consignor role')))))
Equivalent Class: 'information content entity' and (('is about' some (supplier or (('business organization' or person) and ('has role' some 'consignor role')))) and ('is output of' some ('shipment preparation process' and (precedes some ('arrival process' and ('has participant at some time' some shipment)))))) and ('is about' some shipment) and ('is about' some (buyer or consignee))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: information content entity about a shipment, sent by a supplier or consignor to a buyer or consignee, before the shipment’s arrival
iof-av:firstOrderLogicDefinition: AdvanceShipmentNotice(x) ↔ InformationContentEntity(x) ∧ ∃y∃z∃w∃p∃a (Shipment(y) ∧ isAbout(x,y) ∧ ((Buyer(z) ∨ Consignor(z)) ∧ isAbout(x,z)) ∧ ((Supplier(w) ∨ Consignee(w)) ∧ isAbout(x,w)) ∧ ShipmentPreparationProcess(p) ∧ ArrivalProcess(a) ∧ isOutputOf(x,p) ∧ precedes(p,a) ∧ participatesInAtSomeTime(y,a))

LABEL: agent
Equivalent Class: ('engineered system' or 'group of agents' or person) and ('has role' some 'agent role')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: person, group of persons, or engineered system with an agent role

LABEL: agent role
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'role of' some (('material entity' and (not ('fiat object part'))) and ('acts on behalf of at some time' some ('engineered system' or 'group of agents' or person)))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: role that someone or something has when they act on behalf of a person, engineered system or a group of agents
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: AgentRole(x) → Role(x) ∧ ∃n∃m((MaterialEntity(m) ∧ ¬FiatObjectPart(x)) ∧ roleOf(x,m) ∧ (Person(n) ∨ GroupOfAgents(n) ∨ EngineeredSystem(n)) ∧ actsOnBehalfOfAtSomeTime(m, n))

LABEL: agreement
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'has continuant part at all times' some 'objective specification'
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: understanding between two or more parties that contains a set of commitments on the part of the parties

LABEL: airway
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: three-dimensional spatial region that connects one specified location (navigation point) to another at a specified altitude, along which an aircraft may be flown

LABEL: algorithm
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: information content entity that prescribes procedural or declarative steps which can be translated to computer interpretable instructions

LABEL: appraisal process
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: measurement process that involves evaluating, assessing, estimating, or judging the nature, value, importance, condition, or quality of some entity

LABEL: arrival process
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'occupies temporal region' some ('has occurrent part' some ('last instant of' some ( inverse ('occupies temporal region') some ('transport process' or 'travel process'))))|'occurrent part of' some ('transport process' or 'travel process')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: material location change process that consists of the participating entity reaching its destination such that the travel or transport process which it is a part of is completed
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: ArrivalProcess(x) → MaterialLocationChangeProcess(x) ∧ ∃y(TravelProcess(y) ∨ TransportProcess(y)) ∧ occurrentPartOf(x,y) ∧ ∃z∃z1∃t(TemporalRegion(z) ∧ TemporalRegion(z1) ∧ TemporalInstant(t)) ∧ occupiesTemporalRegion(x,z) ∧ occupiesTemporalRegion(y,z1) ∧ lastInstantOf(t,z1) ∧ occupiesTemporalRegion(x,t)

LABEL: assembly
SubClass Of [ANON]: inverse ('component part of at all times') some 'material component'
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: material artifact that is composed of material components that are physically connected and that is capable of disassembly
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: LA1: Assembly(x) → MaterialArtifact(x) ∧ ∃c∃c1(MaterialComponent(c) ∧ MaterialComponent(c1) ∧ componentPartOfAtAllTimes(c,x) ∧ componentPartOfAtAllTimes(c1,x) ∧ ¬(c=c1 ∨ (componentPartOfAtAllTimes(c,c1) ∨ componentPartOfAtAllTimes(c1,c))))|LA2: MaterialArtifact(x) ∧ ∃p(AssemblyProcess(p) ∧ isSpecifiedOutputOf(x,p)) → Assembly(x)

LABEL: assembly process
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'has input' some 'material component'|'has specified output' some (assembly and ('has component part at all times' some ('material component' and ('is input of' some 'manufacturing process'))))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: manufacturing process in which a number of material components are physically connected to each other to form an assembly
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: AssemblyProcess(x) → ManufacturingProcess(x) ∧ ∃a∃c (Assembly(a) ∧ MaterialComponent(c) ∧ isInputOf(c,x) ∧ hasComponentPartAtAllTimes(a,c) ∧ hasSpecifiedOutput(x,a))

LABEL: bill of lading
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'has continuant part at all times' some ('information content entity' and (prescribes only 'consigning process'))|'has continuant part at all times' some ('information content entity' and (prescribes only 'consignor role'))|'has continuant part at all times' some ('information content entity' and (prescribes only 'transportation service provider role'))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: agreement between a shipper and a carrier that prescribes some consigning process
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: LA1: BillOfLading (x) → CommercialServiceAgreement (x) ∧ ∀y∀z(ConsignorRole(y) ∧ CarrierRole(z) ∧ prescribes(x,y) ∧ prescribes(x,z))|LA2: CommercialServiceAgreement (x) ∧ ∃c∃y∃z(ConsigningProcess(c) ∧ ConsignorRole(y) ∧ CarrierRole(z) ∧ isAbout(x,c) ∧ prescribes(x,y) ∧ prescribes(x,z)) → BillofLading(x)

LABEL: business function
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'function of' some organization|'has realization' only 'business process'|'prescribed by' some ('objective specification' and ('generically depends on at some time' some organization))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: function of an organization to partake in for profit activities as prescribed by the objectives specified by that organization
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: LA1: BusinessFunction(x) → Function(x) ∧ ∃o∃i(Organization(o) ∧ ObjectiveSpecification(i) ∧ functionOf(x,o) ∧ genericallyDependsOnAtSomeTime(i,o) ∧ prescribedBy(x,i)) ∧ ∀y(hasRealization(x,y) → BusinessProcess(y))|LA2: Function(x) ∧ ∃o∃i∃p(Organization(o) ∧ ObjectiveSpecification(i) ∧ BusinessProcess(p) ∧ functionOf(x,o) ∧ genericallyDependsOnAtSomeTime(i,o) ∧ prescribedBy(x,i) ∧ hasRealization(x,p)) → BusinessFunction(x)

LABEL: business organization
Equivalent Class: organization and ('bearer of' some 'business function')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: organization engaging in or planning to engage in any activity of buying and selling goods or services for a profit

LABEL: business process
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'has participant at some time' some (agent and ('acts on behalf of at some time' some 'business organization'))|'prescribed by' some ('plan specification' and ('has continuant part at all times' some ('objective specification' and ('generically depends on at some time' some 'business organization'))))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: planned process which is prescribed by a plan specification with one or more objectives specified by a business organization
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: BusinessProcess (p) → PlannedProcess(p) ∧ ∃o∃b∃s∃y (ObjectiveSpecification(o) ∧ BusinessOrganization(b) ∧ PlanSpecification(s) ∧ isCarrierOfAtSomeTime(b,o) ∧ continuantPartofAtAllTimes(o,s) ∧ Agent(y) ∧ actsOnBehalfOfAtSomeTime(y,b) ∧ participatesInAtSomeTime(y,x))

LABEL: buyer
Equivalent Class: (organization or person) and ('has role' some 'buyer role')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: person or organization which has a buyer role

LABEL: buyer role
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'role of' some ((organization or person) and ('participates in at some time' some 'buying business process'))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: agent role held by a person or organization when it buys a product or a service
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: BuyerRole(x) → Role(x) ∧ ∃y∃p ((Organization(y) ∨ Person(y)) ∧ BuyingBusinessProcess(p) ∧ participatesInAtSomeTime(y,p) ∧ roleOf(x, y))

LABEL: buying business process
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'has participant at some time' some ('commercial service agreement' or 'material product')|'has participant at some time' some buyer
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: business process wherein a financial instrument is used by an agent (buyer) to acquire ownership of a product or commercial service from another agent (seller) for the buyer itself or for another agent (customer)
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: BuyingBusinessProcess(x) → BusinessProcess(x) ∧ ∃y∃z((MaterialProduct(y) ∨ CommercialServiceAgreement(y)) ∧ Buyer(z) ∧ hasParticipantAtSomeTIme(x,y) ∧ hasParticipantAtSomeTime(x,z))

LABEL: capability
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: disposition in whose realization some agent has an interest

LABEL: cargo
Equivalent Class: 'material entity' and ('has role' some 'cargo role')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: material entity that is transported using a transport equipment by a carrier

LABEL: cargo role
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'role of' some ('material entity' and ('participates in at some time' some ('transport process' and ('has agent' some carrier))))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: role held by a material entity when it is being transported or is planned to be transported by a carrier
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: CargoRole(x) → Role(x) ∧ ∃m∃p∃c(MaterialEntity(m) ∧ TransportProcess(p) ∧ Carrier(c) ∧ participatesInAtSomeTime(m,p) ∧ agentIn(c,p) ∧ roleOf (x,m))

LABEL: carrier
Equivalent Class: ('business organization' or person) and ('has role' some 'transportation service provider role')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: person or business organization who provides transportation services

LABEL: change
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: process in which some independent continuant endures and 1) one or more of the dependent entities it bears increase or decrease in intensity, 2) the entity begins to bear some dependent entity or 3) the entity ceases to bear some dependent entity

LABEL: classifier
Equivalent Class: denoter and (classifies some entity)
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: denoter that classifies some entity

LABEL: commercial service
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'has occurrent part' some 'supplying business process'|'has participant at some time' some 'service provider'|'is subject of' some 'commercial service agreement'|'prescribed by' some 'commercial service specification'
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: business process that consists of a service provisioning process and a consumption process
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: Commercialervice(x) → BusinessProcess(x) ∧ ∃p∃y∃a∃s(CommercialServiceSpecification(p) ∧ ServiceProvider(y) ∧ CommercialServiceAgreement(s) ∧ SupplyingBusinessProcess(a) ∧ hasParticipantAtSomeTime(x,y) ∧ hasOccurentPart(x,a) ∧ prescribedBy(x,p) ∧ isSubjectOf(x,s))

LABEL: commercial service agreement
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: agreement between a customer and service provider that is about some commercial service to be provided by the service provider in exchange for compensation from the customer
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: Agreement(x) ∧ ∃c∃y∃z(CommercialService(c) ∧ ServiceProviderRole(y) ∧ CustomerRole(z) ∧ isAbout(x,c) ∧ prescribes(x,y) ∧ prescribes(x,z)) → CommercialServiceAgreement(x)

LABEL: commercial service specification
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: plan specification that prescribes a commercial service

LABEL: complex material state
Equivalent Class: 'material state' and ( inverse ('material state holds in') some 'material state')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: material state whose condition is an aggregated condition composed from the conditions of two or more material states that hold in it

LABEL: computing process
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'has input' only 'information content entity'|'has specified output' only 'information content entity'
Equivalent Class: 'planned process' and (('achieves at some time' some ('objective specification' and ('continuant part of at all times' some (algorithm or 'encoded algorithm')))) or ('has specified output' some 'information content entity')) and ('has participant at some time' some agent) and ('concretizes at some time' some ((algorithm or 'encoded algorithm') and ('generically depends on at some time' some agent)))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: planned process in which an algorithm or an encoded algorithm is realized by an agent
iof-av:firstOrderLogicDefinition:
ComputingProcess(x) ↔ PlannedProcess(x) ∧ ∃y∃a(Agent(y) ∧ (Algorithm(a) ∨ EncodedAlgorithm(a)) ∧ hasParticipantAtSomeTIme(x,y) ∧ genericallyDependsOnAtSomeTime(a,y) ∧ concretizesAtSomeTime(x,a) ∧ (∃o(ObjectiveSpecification(o) ∧ continuantPartOfAtAllTimes(o,a) ∧ achievesAtSomeTIme(x,o)) ∨ 
∃i(InformationContentEntity(i) ∧ hasSpecifiedOutput(x,i))))

LABEL: consignee
Equivalent Class: ('business organization' or person) and ('has role' some 'consignee role')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: person or business organization that receives some shipment

LABEL: consignee role
SubClass Of [ANON]: ('participates in at some time' some ('receiving process' and ('has participant at some time' some carrier))) and ('role of' some ('business organization' or person))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: role held by a person or business organization when it receives a shipment from a carrier and owns the shipment after the receipt
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: ConsigneeRole(x) → Role(x) ∧ ∃y∃p((BusinessOrganization(y) ∨ Person(y)) ∧ ReceivingProcess(p) ∧ participatesInAtSomeTime(y,p) ∧ roleOf(x,y))

LABEL: consigning process
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: business process that results in placing a material entity in the possession of some agent without changing the ownership until the material entity is sold

LABEL: consignor role
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'role of' some (('business organization' or person) and ('agent in' some 'consigning process') and ('agent in' some 'shipment preparation process'))|'role of' some (('business organization' or person) and (owns some (shipment and ('is specified output of' some 'shipment preparation process'))))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: role held by a business organization or person when it prepares, initiates, and consigns a shipment it owns
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: LA1:ConsignorRole(x) → Role(x) ∧ ∃y∃p∃s((BusinessOrganization(y) ∨ Person(y)) ∧ ShipmentPreparationProcess(p) ∧ Shipment(s) ∧ agentIn(y,p) ∧ isSpecifiedOutputOf(s,p) ∧ owns(y,s) ∧ roleOf(x,y))|LA2:ConsignorRole(x) → Role(x) ∧ ∃y∃p((BusinessOrganization(y) ∨ Person(y)) ∧ ShipmentPreparationProcess(p) ∧ agentIn(y,p) ∧ roleOf(x,y))

LABEL: consumable
Equivalent Class: 'material entity' and ('has role' some 'consumable role')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: material entity which has the consumable role

LABEL: consumable role
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'has realization' only 'planned process'|('role of' some ('material entity' and (('has capability' some (capability and ('has realization' some 'planned process'))) or ('is input of' some 'planned process')))) or ('role of' some ('material entity' and ('prescribed by' some 'input specification')))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: role held by a material entity when it is planned to be, or is partially or fully used up in a planned process
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: ConsumableRole(x) → Role(x) ∧ ∀y(hasRealization(x,y) → PlannedProcess(y)) ∧ (∃a(roleOf(x,a) ∧ MaterialEntity(a) ∧ (∃f(hasCapability(a,f) ∧ Capability(f) ∧ ∃p(hasRealization(f,p) ∧ PlannedProcess(p))) ∨ ∃p(isInputOf(a,p) ∧ PlannedProcess(p)))) ∨ ∃a(roleOf(x,a) ∧ MaterialEntity(a) ∧ ∃b(prescribedBy(a,b) ∧ InputSpecification(b))))

LABEL: container
Equivalent Class: 'material artifact' and ('has function' some 'material containment function')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: material artifact designed to hold one or more material entities within a bounded interior, cavity, surface-delimited area, or contained site

LABEL: container identifier
Equivalent Class: identifier and (designates some container)
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: identifier that identifies a container

LABEL: customer
Equivalent Class: (organization or person) and ('has role' some 'customer role')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: person or organization which has a customer role

LABEL: customer role
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'role of' some (organization or person)
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: agent role held by a person or organization when it utilizes the product or receives the service or subscribes to the commercial service agreement

LABEL: denoter
Equivalent Class: 'information content entity' and (denotes some entity)
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: information content entity that denotes some entity

LABEL: departure process
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'occupies temporal region' some ('has occurrent part' some ('first instant of' some ( inverse ('occupies temporal region') some ('transport process' or 'travel process'))))|'occurrent part of' some ('transport process' or 'travel process')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: material location change process that consists of the participating entity leaving its starting location such that the travel or transport process it is a part of is initiated
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: DepartureProcess(x) → MaterialLocationChangeProcess(x) ∧ ∃y(TravelProcess(y) ∨ TransportProcess(y)) ∧ occurrentPartOf(x,y) ∧ ∃z∃z1∃t(TemporalRegion(z) ∧ TemporalRegion(z1) ∧ TempotalInstance(t)) ∧ occupiesTemporalRegion(x,z) ∧ occupiesTemporalRegion(y,z1) ∧ firstInstanceOf(t,z1) ∧ occupiesTemporalRegion(x,t)

LABEL: descriptive information content entity
Equivalent Class: 'information content entity' and (describes some entity)
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: information content entity that characterizes (gives a description of) an entity

LABEL: design specification
SubClass Of [ANON]: prescribes only continuant
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: information content entity that prescribes something man-made
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: LA1: DesignSpecification(x) → InformationContentEntity(x) ∧ ∀c (prescribes(x,c) → Continuant(c))|LA2: InformationContentEntity(x) ∧ ∃c∃r(Continuant(c) ∧ RequirementSpecification(r) ∧ satisfiesRequirement(x,r) ∧ prescribes(x,c)) ∧ ∀c1(prescribes(x,c1) → Continuant(c1)) → DesignSpecification(x)

LABEL: designative information content entity
Equivalent Class: 'information content entity' and (designates some entity)
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: information content entity that uniquely identifies an entity

LABEL: designed function
Equivalent Class: function and ('prescribed by' some 'design specification')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: function that is intentionally designed

LABEL: directive information content entity
Equivalent Class: 'information content entity' and (prescribes some entity)
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: information content entity that prescribes a set of rules or guidelines for a process or a model of something man-made

LABEL: distribution center
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: storage facility designed to store manufactured products that are to be distributed to resellers and wholesalers

LABEL: distributor
Equivalent Class: ('business organization' or person) and ('has role' some 'distributor role')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: person or business organization when it purchases products from manufacturers and resells them to wholesalers

LABEL: distributor role
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'role of' some (('business organization' or person) and ('agent in' some ('offering for sale business process' and (realizes some ('material product role' and ('role of' some 'material entity'))))))|'role of' some (('business organization' or person) and ('agent in' some ('supplying business process' and (realizes some ('buyer role' and ('role of' some wholesaler))) and (realizes some ('material product role' and ('role of' some 'material entity'))))))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: role held by a person or business organization when it buys some material products from a manufacturer and resells them to a wholesaler
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: LA1:DistributorRole(x) → AgentRole(x) ∧ ∃y∃p∃r∃m((BusinessOrganization(y) ∨ Person(y)) ∧ roleOf(x,y) ∧ OfferingForSaleBusinessProcess(p) ∧ MaterialProductRole(r) ∧ MaterialEntity(m) ∧ agentIn(y,p) ∧ realizes(p,r) ∧ roleOf(r,m))|LA2:DistributorRole(x) → AgentRole(x) ∧ ∃y∃p∃r∃r1∃r2∃m∃d((BusinessOrganization(y) ∨ Person(y)) ∧ roleOf(x,y) ∧ BuyerRole(r) ∧ hasRole(y,r) ∧ BuyingBusinessProcess(p) ∧ hasRealization(r,p) ∧ MaterialProductRole(r1) ∧ SupplierRole(r2) ∧ MaterialEntity(m) ∧ Manufacturer(d) ∧ realizes(p,r1) ∧ roleOf(r1,m) ∧ realizes(p,r2) ∧ roleOf(r2,d))|LA3:DistributorRole(x) → AgentRole(x) ∧ ∃y∃p∃r1∃r2∃m∃e((BusinessOrganization(y) ∨ Person(y)) ∧ roleOf(x,y) ∧ SupplyingBusinessProcess(p) ∧ agentIn(y,p) ∧ Wholesaler(w) ∧ BuyerRole(r1) ∧ roleOf(r1,w) ∧ MaterialEntity(m) ∧ MaterialProductRole(r2) ∧ roleOf(r2,m) ∧ realizes(p,r1) ∧ realizes(p,r2))

LABEL: encoded algorithm
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: plan specification that is the implementation of an algorithm encoded in a specific programming language or framework and that is readily executable

LABEL: engineered system
Equivalent Class: system and ('bearer of' some 'designed function')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: system that is deliberately created to have a certain function

LABEL: equipment role
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'has realization' only ('planned process' and (realizes some (function and ('function of' some ('engineered system' or 'material artifact')))))|'role of' only ('engineered system' or 'material artifact')|'role of' some (('engineered system' or 'material artifact') and ('prescribed by' some ('plan specification' or ('continuant part of at all times' some 'plan specification'))))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: role held by a material artifact or an engineered system when it is planned to be involved in or is involved in carrying out some part of a planned process and that is not consumed in that planned process
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: LA1: EquipmentRole(x) → ∀y (hasRealization(x,y) → (PlannedProcess(y) ∧ ∃f (Function(f) ∧ realizes(y,f) ∧ ∃z ((EngineeredSystem(z) ∨ MaterialArtifact(z)) ∧ functionOf(f,z)))))|LA2: EquipmentRole(x) → ∀y (roleOf(x,y) → (EngineeredSystem(y) ∨ MaterialArtifact(y)))|LA3: EquipmentRole(x) → ∃y ( roleOf(x,y) ∧ (EngineeredSystem(y) ∨ MaterialArtifact(y)) ∧ ∃z ( prescribedBy(y,z) ∧ ( PlanSpecification(z) ∨ ∃p ( PlanSpecification(p) ∧ continuantPartOfAtAllTimes(z,p) ) ) ) )

LABEL: event
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'recognized by at some time' some agent|process or 'process boundary'
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: phenomena (process or process boundary) that is recognized by an agent and typically recorded

LABEL: facility

iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: engineered system that consists of buildings, structures, roads, machines, and equipment designed to provide certain capabilities

LABEL: factory

iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: facility that is designed for manufacturing products and includes one or more production systems

LABEL: freight container
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: A container that is designed to enclose, protect, and enable the transport of one or more material entities across multiple modes of transportation

LABEL: freight forwarder

iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: person or business organization when it arranges the transportation of shipments on behalf of the shipper (consignor) or consignee

LABEL: freight forwarder role
Equivalent Class: 'logistics service provider role' and ('role of' some (('business organization' or person) and ('acts on behalf of at some time' some (consignee or consignor)) and ('agent in' some 'freight forwarding service')))

LABEL: gain of role
Equivalent Class: process and (('occupies temporal region' some ('temporal interval' and ((meets some ('temporal interval' and ( inverse ('exists at') some role))) or ('temporally overlaps' some ('temporal interval' and ( inverse ('exists at') some role))) or ('temporally starts' some ('temporal interval' and ( inverse ('exists at') some role)))))) and ('has output' some role)) and ('has participant at all times' some ('independent continuant' and (not ('spatial region'))))

LABEL: geospatial location
Equivalent Class: 'geospatial site' and ('has role' some 'location role')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: geospatial site that is the location of some material entity at some time or the site of some process

LABEL: geospatial site

LABEL: global location number

LABEL: group of agents

iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: group (object aggregate) that has one or more agents as members

LABEL: group of persons
Equivalent Class: 'object aggregate' and ('has member part at some time' some person) and ('has member part at some time' only person)
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: group (object aggregate) that has one or more persons as members
iof-av:firstOrderLogicDefinition: GroupOfPersons(x) ↔ ObjectAggregate(x) ∧ ∃y(Person(y) ∧ hasMemberPartAtSomeTime(x, y)) ∧ ∀z(hasMemberPartAtSomelTime(x, z) → Person(z))

LABEL: group of suppliers

iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: GroupOfSuppliers(x) → OrganizedGroupOfAgents(x) ∧ ∀y∃r∃s(BusinessOrganization(y) ∧ (SupplierRole(r) ∧ SupplyRelationship(s) ∧ specificallyDependedOnBy(r,s) ∧ ∃p(SupplyChainPlanSpecification(p) ∧ prescribes(p,s)) ∧ hasRole(y,r) ∧ hasMemberPartAtAllTimes(x,y)))

LABEL: identifier

iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: denoter that is used to uniquely identify an entity within a particular context

LABEL: industrial inventory
Equivalent Class: ('material artifact' or 'material component' or 'material product' or 'raw material') and ('has role' some 'industrial inventory role')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: material product, material component, raw material, or material artifact that is ready to be sold or used and is stored in a storage facility or on factory floor
iof-av:firstOrderLogicDefinition: IndustrialInventory(x) ↔ (MaterialArtifact(x) ∨ MaterialComponent(x) v MaterialProduct(x) v RawMaterial(x)) ∧ ∃r(IndustrialInventoryRole(r) ∧ hasRole(x,r))

LABEL: industrial inventory role
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'role of' some ('material entity' and ('participates in at some time' some ('product production process' or 'supplying business process')))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: role held by some material entity when it is stored by a business organization and it is intended to be supplied to a customer or to be used or consumed in some product production process
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: IndustrialInventoryRole(x) → MaterialResourceRole(x) ∧ ∃m∃p(MaterialEntity(m) ∧ (ProductProductionProcess(p) ∨ SupplyingBusinessProcess(p)) ∧ participatesInAtSomeTime(m,p) ∧ ∃i(InventoryManagementProcess(i) ∧ participatesInAtSomeTime(m,i) ∧ roleOf(x,m)))

LABEL: industry
SubClass Of [ANON]: ('has member part at all times' some 'business organization') and ('has member part at all times' only 'business organization')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: group of organizations that are related based on their primary business activities

LABEL: information content entity
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: content or a pattern (generically dependent continuant) that is about some entity

LABEL: input specification
SubClass Of [ANON]: prescribes only ((continuant and ('is input of' some 'planned process')) or ('specifically dependent continuant' and ('specifically depends on' some (continuant and ('is input of' some 'planned process')))))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: information content entity that prescribes the entities to be used as inputs to a planned process or the attributes they must posses to serve as valid inputs

LABEL: integrated carrier business organization
Equivalent Class: 'business organization' and ('has function' some 'freight forwarding business function') and ('has function' some 'transportation business function')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: business organization that is created for the purpose of providing different types of transportation and freight forwarding services

LABEL: inventory management process
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: business process that consists of the activities required for controlling, tracking, recording, and planning inventories

LABEL: load
Equivalent Class: 'material entity' and ('has role' some 'load role')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: collection of material entities which share the same transportation and transfer history

LABEL: load role
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'role of' some ('material entity' and ('participates in at some time' some 'material location change process'))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: traceable resource unit role held by a number of material entities that have been transferred or transported together
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: LoadRole(x) → TraceableResouceUnitRole(x) ∧ ∃m∃p(MaterialEntity(m) ∧ MaterialLocationChangeProcess(p) ∧ participatesInAtSomeTime(m,p) ∧ ∃i(Identifier(i) ∧ designates(i,m)) ∧ roleOf(x,m))

LABEL: location identification scheme
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: identification scheme that prescribes how unique identifiers of physical locations are formulated

LABEL: location role
Equivalent Class: role and ('role of' some ('geospatial site' and (('location of at some time' some 'material entity') or ('is site of' some process))))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: role held by a geospatial site when it is the location of some material entity at some time or the site of some process
iof-av:firstOrderLogicDefinition: LocationRolel(x) ↔ Role(x) ∧ ∃g(GeospatialSite(g) ∧ roleOf(x,g)) ∧ ∃m∃p(Process(p) ∧ MaterialEntity(m) ∧ locationOfAtSometime(g,m) ∨ isSiteOf(g,p))

LABEL: logistic unit
Equivalent Class: 'material entity' and ('designated by' some identifier) and ('has role' some 'logistic unit role')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: material entities packaged together for transport or storage

LABEL: logistic unit role
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: traceable resource unit role held by a number of material entities that are packaged together for transport or storage

LABEL: logistics process
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'business process' and ('has occurrent part' some ('freight forwarding process' or 'receiving process' or 'shipment preparation process' or 'storage process' or 'transport process'))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: business process composed of one or more processes such as transport, shipment preparation, storage, or receiving that are coordinated to enable the movement, handling, or distribution of material entities across one or more locations within a supply chain
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: LogisticsProcess(x) → BusinessProcess(x) ∧ ∃p((ReceivingProcess(p) ∨ ShipmentPreparationProcess(p) ∨ StorageProcess(p) ∨ FreightForwardingProcess(p) ∨ TransportProcess(p)) ∧ hasOccurrentPart (x,p))

LABEL: logistics service
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'has occurrent part' some ('freight forwarding process' or 'packaging process' or 'transport process')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: commercial service that consists of at least one transport process, packaging process, freight forwarding, or storage process
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: LogisticsService(x) → CommercialService(x) ∧ ∃p((TransportationProcess(p) ∨ FreightForwardingProcess(p) ∨ PackagingProcess(p) ∨ StorageProcess(p)) ∧ hasOccurentPart(x,p))

LABEL: logistics service provider role
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'role of' some (('business organization' or person) and ('agent in' some 'logistics service'))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: service provider role that is held by a business organization or person when it provides a logistics service
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: LogisticsServiceProviderRole(x) → ServiceProviderRole(x) ∧ ∃y∃p(BusinessOrganization(y) ∨ Person(y) ∧ LogisticsService(p) ∧ agentIn(y,p) ∧ roleOf(x,y))

LABEL: loss of role
Equivalent Class: process and (('occupies temporal region' some ('temporal interval' and (('is temporally overlapped by' some ('temporal interval' and ( inverse ('exists at') some role))) or ('met by' some ('temporal interval' and ( inverse ('exists at') some role))) or ('temporally finishes' some ('temporal interval' and ( inverse ('exists at') some role)))))) and ('has input' some role)) and ('has participant at all times' some ('independent continuant' and (not ('spatial region'))))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: process in which someone or something (independent continuant that is not a spatial region) ceases to be the bearer of a role
iof-av:firstOrderLogicDefinition: LossOfRole(p) ↔ Process(p) ∧ ∃t∃t1∃r∃y(TemporalInterval(t) ∧ TemporalInterval(t1) ∧ Role(r) ∧ (IndependentContinuant(y) ∧ ¬SpatialRegion(y)) ∧ occupiesTemporalRegion(p,t) ∧ (isTemporallyOverlappedBy(t,t1) ∨ temporallyFinishes(t,t1) ∨ metBy(t,t1)) ∧ hasInput(p,r) ∧ existsAt(r,t1) ∧ hasRole(y,r) ∧ hasParticipantAtAllTimes(p,y) ∧ ∀t2(TemporalRegion(t2) ∧ existsAt(r,t2) → (occurrentPartOf(t2,t1) ∨ t2 = t1)))

LABEL: lot
Equivalent Class: 'material entity' and ('designated by' some 'lot identifier') and ('has role' some 'lot role')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: quantity of material entities produced together and sharing the same production history and specifications

LABEL: lot identifier
Equivalent Class: identifier and (designates some lot)
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: identifier that uniquely denotes a particular quantity of material entities that have shared production or transformation history

LABEL: lot role
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'role of' some ('material entity' and ('participates in at some time' some 'manufacturing process') and ('designated by' some 'lot identifier'))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: traceable resource unit role held by material entities that have a shared production or transformation history
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: LotRole(x) → TraceableResouceUnitRole(x) ∧ ∃m∃p(MaterialEntity(m) ∧ ManufacturingProcess(p) ∧ participatesInAtSomeTime(m,p) ∧ ∃i(LotNumber(i) ∧ designates(i,m)) ∧ roleOf(x,m))

LABEL: maintainable material item
Equivalent Class: ('engineered system' or 'material artifact') and ('has role' some 'maintainable material item role')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: material artifact or engineered system which has the maintainable material item role

LABEL: maintainable material item role
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: role played by an asset (engineered system or material artifact) when there is a maintenance strategy prescribing its maintenance process

LABEL: make-to-order production capability
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: production capability to manufacture some material artifact only after a confirmed customer order is received

LABEL: make-to-stock production capability
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: production capability to manufacture and store some product to fulfill the expected incoming orders or forecasted demand

LABEL: manufacturer
Equivalent Class: organization and ('has role' some 'manufacturer role')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: organization which has a manufacturer role

LABEL: manufacturer role
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'role of' some (organization and ('participates in at some time' some 'product production process'))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: agent role held by an organization when it produces material products

LABEL: manufacturing process
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'has input' some 'material entity'|'has participant at some time' some (agent and ('is carrier of at some time' some 'plan specification'))|'has specified output' some ('material artifact' or ('material entity' and ('prescribed by' some 'design specification')))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: planned process that consists of a structured set of operations through which input material is transformed or modified
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: ManufacturingProcess(x) → PlannedProcess(x) ∧ ∃m∃y∃p∃z(MaterialEntity(m) ∧ (MaterialArtifact(y) ∨ ∃d(MaterialEntity(y) ∧ DesignSpecification(d) ∧ prescribes(d,y))) ∧ PlanSpecification(p) ∧ prescribes(p,x) ∧ Agent(z) ∧ isCarrierOfAtSomeTime(z,p) ∧ participatesInAtSomeTime(z,x) ∧ isInputOf(m,x) ∧ hasSpecifiedOutput(x,y))

LABEL: manufacturing service

iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: commercial service that consists of at least one manufacturing process

LABEL: manufacturing service provider role
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'role of' some (('business organization' or person) and ('agent in' some 'manufacturing service'))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: service provider role that is held by a person or business organization when it provides a manufacturing service
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: ManufacturingServiceProviderRole(x) → ServiceProviderRole(x) ∧ ∃y∃p((BusinessOrganization(y) ∨ Person(y)) ∧ ManufacturingService(p) ∧ agentIn(y,p) ∧ roleOf(x,y))

LABEL: manufacturing supply chain system
Equivalent Class: 'supply chain system' and ('participates in at some time' some ('supply chain process' and ('has specified output' some 'material product')))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: supply chain system that is formed to manufacture one or more products

LABEL: material artifact

iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: object that is deliberately created to have a certain function

LABEL: material component

iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: material entity which has the material component role

LABEL: material component role
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'role of' some 'material entity'
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: role held by a material entity when it is a proper part of another material entity or is planned to be a proper part of another material entity

LABEL: material containment capability
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'capability of' some 'material entity'
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: capability of a material entity that is grounded in the entity’s physical structure and that can be realized in a process in which the entity holds one or more material entities within a bounded interior, cavity, surface-delimited area, or contained site

LABEL: material containment function
Equivalent Class: 'material containment capability' and ('function of' some 'material entity')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: material containment capability that is a function of a material entity

LABEL: material location change process
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'has participant at some time' some ('material entity' and ( inverse ('location of at all times') some ('independent continuant' and ('located in at all times' some site) and ('exists at' some ('temporal instant' and (('first instant of' some 'temporal region') and ( inverse ('occupies temporal region') some 'planned process')))))) and ( inverse ('location of at all times') some ('independent continuant' and ('located in at all times' some site) and ('exists at' some ('temporal instant' and ('last instant of' some ('temporal region' and ( inverse ('occupies temporal region') some 'planned process'))))))))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: planned process that results in a material entity moving from one physical location to another
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom:
MaterialLocationChangeProcess(​x​) → PlannedProcess(​x)​ ∧ ​∃​y∃​​t∃​​t​1∃​​t2∃​s∃​s1∃​z∃​z1(MaterialEntity(​y​) ∧ TemporalInstant(t) ∧ TemporalInstant(t1) ∧ TemporalRegion(t2) ∧ IndependentContinuant(s) ∧ IndependentContinuant(s1) ∧ Site(z) ∧ Site(z1) ∧ hasParticipantAtSomeTime(x,y)
∧ firstInstantOf(​t​, ​t2) ∧ lastInstantOf(​t1​, ​t2​) ∧ occupiesTemporalRegion(​x,​t2)​ ∧ existsAt(s,t) ∧ existsAt(s1,t1) ∧ locatedInAtalltimes(s,z) ∧ locatedInAtAlltimes(s1,z1) ∧ locationOfAtAlltimes(s,y) ∧ locationOfAtAllTimes(s1,y))

LABEL: material product
Equivalent Class: 'material entity' and ('has role' some 'material product role')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: material entity which has the material product role

LABEL: material product role
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'role of' some ('material entity' and ('participates in at some time' some ('buying business process' or 'offering for sale business process' or 'supplying business process')))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: role held by a material entity that is intended to be sold, or has been bought, or has been supplied
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: MaterialProductRole(x) → Role(x) ∧ ∃y∃z((BuyingBusinessProcess(y) ∨ OfferingForSaleBusinessProcess(y) ∨ SupplyingBusinessProcess(y)) ∧ MaterialEntity(z) ∧ participatesInAtSomeTime(z,y) ∧ roleOf(x,z))

LABEL: material resource
Equivalent Class: 'material entity' and ('has role' some 'material resource role')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: material entity which has the material resource role

LABEL: material resource role
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'role of' some ('material entity' and ('is available to at some time' some ('engineered system' or 'group of agents' or person)))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: role played by a material entity that consists in it being available to a person or group of agents or engineered system
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: MaterialResourceRole(x) → Role(x) ∧ ∃a∃y((Person(a) ∨ GroupOfAgents(a) ∨ EngineeredSystem(y)) ∧ MaterialEntity(y) ∧ isAvailableToAtSomeTime(y,a) ∧ roleOf(x,y))

LABEL: material state
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'has occurrent part' only ('process boundary' or 'material state')|'is material state of' some 'material entity'
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: process in which a material entity that participates in the process has a condition that remains unchanged
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: LA1: MaterialState(s) → ∃m(MaterialEntity(m) ∧ isMaterialStateOf(s,m))|LA2: ∀s,s′,m((isMaterialStateOf(s,m) ∧ occurrentPartOf(s′,s) ∧ Process(s′)) → (MaterialState(s′) ∧ isMaterialStateOf(s′,m)))

SubClass Of [ANON]: 'continuant part of at all times' some 'material state specification'|'has continuant part at some time' only (not ('material state condition expression'))|'is value expression of at some time' only ('specifically dependent continuant' or 'generically dependent continuant' or 'process profile' or 'process characteristic')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: value expression that, as part of a material state specification, expresses a condition on a characteristic, profile, quality, location, or other relevant feature, to which the material state prescribed by that specification continuously conforms throughout its occurrence
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: LA1: MaterialStateConditionExpression(x) → ValueExpression(x) ∧ ∃y(MaterialStateSpecification(y) ∧ continuantPartOfAtAllTimes(x,y))|LA2: MaterialStateConditionExpression(x) ∧ isValueExpressionOfAtSomeTime(x,y) → SpecificallyDependentContinuant(y) ∨ GenericallyDependentContinuant(y) ∨ ProcessProfile(y) ∨ ProcessCharacteristic(y)|LA3: MaterialStateConditionExpression(x) ∧ hasContinuantPartAtSomeTime(x,y) → ¬MaterialStateConditionExpression(y)|LA4: ValueExpression(x) ∧ ∃y(MaterialStateSpecification(y) ∧ continuantPartOfAtAllTimes(x,y)) ∧ ∃z((SpecificallyDependentContinuant(z) ∨ GenericallyDependentContinuant(z) ∨ ProcessProfile(z) ∨ ProcessCharacteristic(z)) ∧ isValueExpressionOfAtAllTimes(x,z)) → MaterialStateConditionExpression(x)

LABEL: material trade item
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'material entity' and ('continuant part of at some time' some 'logistic unit')
Equivalent Class: 'material entity' and ('has role' some 'material trade item role')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: material entity that is uniquely identified and is intended to be offered for sale in a selling business process.

LABEL: material trade item role
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'role of' some ('material product' and ('participates in at some time' some 'offering for sale business process') and ('designated by' some identifier))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: role of a material product, package of, or group of material products when it is intended to be offered for sale in a selling business process and is identified for trade.

          SellingBusinessProcess(p) ∧
          ParticipatesInAtSomeTime(y, p) ∧
          Identifier(i) ∧
          designatedBy(y, i)
      )
    )

LABEL: measured value expression

iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: value expression that contains the measured value of an attribute (specifically dependent continuant or process characteristic or process profile or temporal region)
iof-av:firstOrderLogicDefinition:
MeasuredValueSpecification(x) ↔ ValueExpression(x) ∧ ∃e((TemporalRegion(e) ∨ ProcessCharacteristic(e) ∨ ProcessProfile(e) ∨ SpecificallyDependentContinuant(e)) 
∧ isMeasuredValueOfAtSomeTime(x,e))

LABEL: measurement capability
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'capability of' some 'material entity'|'has realization' only 'measurement process'
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: capability of a material entity to measure the value of some entity

LABEL: measurement information content entity
Equivalent Class: 'information content entity' and ('has continuant part at all times' some 'measured value expression') and (describes some ('temporal region' or 'specifically dependent continuant' or 'process profile' or 'process characteristic')) and ('is about' some (process or 'process boundary' or ('independent continuant' and (not ('spatial region'))))) and ('is output of' some 'measurement process')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: informational content that is the result of measuring a set of attributes (specifically dependent continuant or process characteristic or temporal region) belonging to the entity (independent continuant or process or process boundary) the informational content is about
iof-av:firstOrderLogicDefinition: LA1: MeasurementInformationContentEntity(x) ↔ InformationContentEntity(x) ∧ ∃y∃z∃m∃p(((IndependentContinuant(y) ∧ ¬SpatialRegion(y) ∧ SpecificallyDependentContinuant(z) ∧ bearerOf(y,z)) ∨ ((Process(y) ∨ ProcessBoundary(y)) ∧ TemporalRegion(z) ∧ occupiesTemporalRegion(y,z)) ∨ (Process(y) ∧ ProcessCharacteristic(z) ∧ processCharacteristicOf(z,y)) ∨ (ProcessProfile(z) ∧ processProfileOf(z,y))) ∧ MeasuredValueExpression(m) ∧ MeasurementProcess(p) ∧ isAbout(x,y) ∧ describes(x,z) ∧ hasContinuantPartAtAllTimes(x,m) ∧ isMeasuredValueOf(m,y) ∧ isOutputOf(x,p))

LABEL: measurement process
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'has participant at some time' some (('material entity' and ('has capability' some 'measurement capability')) and ('measures at some time' some ('temporal region' or 'specifically dependent continuant' or 'process profile' or 'process characteristic')))|'has specified output' only 'measurement information content entity'
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: planned process to determine the value of an attribute (specifically dependent continuant or temporal region or process characteristic or process profile) of an entity of interest
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: LA1: MeasurementProcess(x) ↔ PlannedProcess(x) ∧ ∃m∃y∃z∃c(MaterialEntity(m) ∧ MeasurementCapability(c) ∧ hasCapability(m,c) ∧ (((IndependentContinuant(y) ∧ ¬SpatialRegion(y)) ∧ SpecificallyDependentContinuant(z) ∧ bearerOf(y,z) ∧ participatesInAtSomeTime(y,x)) ∨ ((Process(y) ∨ ProcessBoundary(y)) ∧ TemporalRegion(z) ∧ occupiesTemporalRegion(y,z) ∧ ∃t(temporalRegion(t) ∧ occupiesTemporalRegion(x,t) ∧ (occurrentPartOf(t,z) ∨ hasOccurrentPart(t,z))) ∨ (ProcessCharacteristic(z) ∧ processCharacteristicOf(z,y)) ∨ (ProcessProfile(z) ∧ processProfileOf(z,y) ∧ (preceedes(y,x) ∨ ∃t1∃t2(temporalRegion(t1) ∧ temporalRegion(t2) ∧ occupiesTemporalRegion(x,t1) ∧ occupiesTemporalRegion(y,t2) ∧ (occurrentPartOf(t1,t2) ∨ hasOccurrentPart(t1,t2))))))) ∧ measuresAtSomeTime(m,z)) ∧ ∀b(hasSpecifiedOutput(x,b) → MeasurementInformationContentEntity(b))

LABEL: objective specification
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: information content entity that prescribes what the outcome of some process should be

iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: plan specification that prescribes a warehousing process

LABEL: warehousing process
Equivalent Class: 'business process' and ('occurs in' some 'storage facility') and ('has occurrent part' some 'storage process') and ('prescribed by' some 'warehousing plan specification')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: business process of storing products (material products) in a storage facility for future use
iof-av:firstOrderLogicDefinition: WarehousingProcess(x) ↔ BusinessProcess(x) ∧ ∃p∃w∃f((StorageProcess(p) ∧ WarehousingPlanSpecification(w) ∧ StorageFacility(f)) ∧ occursIn (x,f) ∧ hasOccurrentPart(x,p) ∧ prescribedBy (x,w))

LABEL: wholesaler
Equivalent Class: agent and ('has role' some 'wholesaler role')
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: person or business organization that buys products from distributors and resells them to retailers or other business organizations

LABEL: wholesaler role
SubClass Of [ANON]: 'role of' some (('business organization' or person) and ('agent in' some ('offering for sale business process' and (realizes some ('material product role' and ('role of' some 'material entity'))))))|'role of' some (('business organization' or person) and ('agent in' some ('supplying business process' and (realizes some ('buyer role' and ('role of' some retailer))) and (realizes some ('material product role' and ('role of' some 'material entity'))))))|'role of' some (('business organization' or person) and ('has role' some ('buyer role' and ('has realization' some ('buying business process' and (realizes some ('material product role' and ('role of' some 'material entity'))) and (realizes some ('supplier role' and ('role of' some distributor))))))))
iof-av:naturalLanguageDefinition: role held by a person or business organization when it buys some product from a distributor and resells them to retailers
iof-av:firstOrderLogicAxiom: LA1:WholesalerRole(x) → AgentRole(x) ∧ ∃y∃p∃r∃m((BusinessOrganization(y) ∨ Person(y)) ∧ roleOf(x,y) ∧ OfferingForSaleBusinessProcess(p) ∧ MaterialProductRole(r) ∧ MaterialEntity(m) ∧ agentIn(y,p) ∧ realizes(p,r) ∧ roleOf(r,m))|LA2:WholesalerRole(x) → AgentRole(x) ∧ ∃y∃p∃r1∃r2∃m∃e((BusinessOrganization(y) ∨ Person(y)) ∧ roleOf (x,y) ∧ SupplyingBusinessProcess(p) ∧ agentIn(y,p) ∧ Retailer(e) ∧ BuyerRole(r1) ∧ roleOf(r1,e) ∧ MaterialEntity(m) ∧ MaterialProductRole(r2) ∧ roleOf(r2,m) ∧ realizes(p,r1) ∧ realizes(p,r2))|LA3:WholesalerRole(x) → AgentRole(x) ∧ ∃y∃p∃r∃r1∃r2∃m∃d((BusinessOrganization(y) ∨ Person(y)) ∧ roleOf (x,y) ∧ BuyerRole(r) ∧ hasRole(y,r) ∧ BuyingBusinessProcess(p) ∧ hasRealization(r,p) ∧ MaterialProductRole(r1) ∧ SupplierRole(r2) ∧ MaterialEntity(m) ∧ Distributor(d) ∧ realizes(p,r1) ∧ roleOf(r1,m) ∧ realizes(p,r2) ∧ roleOf(r2,d))
